basic_details.job_title: GBPUAT Research Associate Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Agrometeorology, G. B. Pant University of Agriculture & Technology, Pantnagar, has invited applications for one Research Associate-I fellowship (Unreserved) under the project "Society centric participatory approach for efficient resources management through science and technology hub 'SPARSH'", code-8069. The fellowship lasts 6 months with an emolument of 58000/, and the required qualification is a PhD in major disciplines of Agricultural Sciences. Applications are sent to the Principal Investigator on his/her departmental address by 14 November 2026, and the interview is on

how_to_apply: Fill in the Application Form printed in the notice. It asks for the name of the fellowship, name of the project, name of the applicant, father's name, date of birth, address, mobile number and email ID, category of the candidate, experience if any, and research papers published.
Fill the education qualification table of the form: exam passed, name of the Board/University, year of passing, percentage of marks (OGPA), division, subject and remarks.
Sign the form as the applicant.
Enclose self-attested copies of all certificates, degrees and testimonials.
Send the application to the Principal Investigator on his/her departmental address, so that it is received by 14 November 2026. The notice does not print a street address.
important_instructions: No separate interview letter will be issued. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. Self-attested copies of all certificates, degrees and testimonials must be enclosed with the application. Originals must be produced at the time of interview. No interim correspondence will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GBPUAT Research Associate-I
content_sections.text: Fill in the Application Form printed in the notice. It asks for the name of the fellowship, name of the project, name of the applicant, father's name, date of birth, address, mobile number and email ID, category of the candidate, experience if any, and research papers published. Fill the education qualification table of the form: exam passed, name of the Board/University, year of passing, percentage of marks (OGPA), division, subject and remarks. Sign the form as the applicant. Enclose self-attested copies of all certificates, degrees and testimonials. Send the application to the Principal Investigator on his/her departmental address, so that it is received by 14 November 2026. The notice does not print a street address.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice announces an interview on 17.11.2026 at 10.00 a.m. Candidates must produce the originals of their certificates at the time of interview. No separate interview letter will be issued, and no TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. The notice does not give the interview venue or describe how candidates are shortlisted.
